discovery: Verified SIFT and original HSV<=0.5. Direct, no self matches or transitive promotion. 4x4 reference grid, 1px spatial deduplication. Region needs >=4 sites with direct corroboration in >=2 distinct 0.8s source-time bins; query needs >=3 distinct stable sites. Shared original quality floor 8, <=2 views/ID, <=6 IDs, <=8 regions/view, <=2 revisions. Temporal bins suppress adjacent repetitions but do not establish independence.
proposals: A1: up to first six frozen v06 groups, their two widest supported old core views. A2: rank group-blind anchor proposals by new direct support bins, then total bins, then earlier source index; suppress coarse proposals with direct-profile Jaccard>=0.8 or insufficient two-bin coverage; gather up to 10, then use local feature coverage novelty to select up to six. A second view in A2 must directly match the seed, positively overlap its profile and cover at least one additional 0.8s bin. Both arms examine every candidate against the same bank of direct verified pair evidence for the union of seed references. A2 has no group labels or memberships as input to seed selection or construction.
scoring: Positive score is the best view's sum of matched regional weights divided by original region count. Require two matched regions and raw fraction>=0.25 to compete. Decide only if positive pairwise margin>=0.12 versus every competing candidate with direct positive support. Unknown/ties retained. Pairwise reweighting does not turn an unmatched feature into negative evidence.
revision: Round 1: for each ordered candidate/rival comparison, downgrade to 0.25 each feature actually seen in >=50% of rival initial support bins and >=2 bins. Profiles frozen before decisions. Round 2: test deletion of at most one downweighted feature per ordered candidate/rival. Commit only if empirical win/loss comparison sets stay exact and no initially eligible positive coverage is lost; otherwise revert. Record coverage, comparison rows and original/revised states. No new promotion, free-running iteration or sweep.
negative: Three states present/absent_supported/unknown. Real video unmatched or outside inspected scope always unknown. A3 only vetoes a candidate with positive support and a predeclared required feature shown absent in an independently validated visible local scope with applicability/reliability/source. Unknown and present cause no veto. Never infer permanent physical identity or absence. Controlled fixed-panel counterexamples exercise this logic, separate from actual video metrics.
downstream: Reuse v06 refine (including occurrences, midpoint, motion and photometric checks) with normalized positive regional distance adapter. v05 deliver budget8 and V/uniform frozen. Fresh 10fps resample each arm on main using first automatic bracket +/-0.5s else middle third; A3 may share query when same prediction. v08 triplet evidence read-only diagnostic, no gate.
evaluation: Smoke on controlled observations and main first then remaining14 with the same locked parameters. Truth only read after each prediction set is fixed, full batch comparison after all predictions. Old clear labels, synthetic states, common exclusion union of v05/A0/A1/A2 refs, first chronological candidate only. No independently held-out real footage, no Agent scoring. Record non-core and all-reviewed denominators. Branch B static/moved/occluded/cut/revisit/contradictory cases with explicit observation inputs, independent of A. P2 separate research.
